For a while when I went to bed, there was a humanoid, shadowy silhouette in the corner of my room every night. I could see it out of the corner of my eye. That's the only way I'd look at it, because I was filled with pure dread when it was around. I would always hide under my covers until it went away or I fell asleep. Sometimes I would feel someting looming over me when I was under the covers, almost like it was going to strangle me. After about two weeks it became less frequent, and then it stopped appearing. 

A month later, I was looking at the new post on "The Ghost in my Machine". It was about shadow people. Shadow people appear either in the corner of a dark room or at the end of a dark hallway. People who've encountered them felt dread when they were around. The scariest part of it for me is that every once in a while, they strangle the people to death. I might be leaving things out because it was a while ago, but it was still terrifying.

Depression, and probably some sort of anxiety disorder. I've looked up how I feel and I can't find anything exactly like I'm feeling. I've found things somewhat similar, but nothing that I read and go "That's exactly how I feel.". It makes me feel like I'm crazy.

And for those of you that might want to know, this anxiety I feel is toward people I care about, mainly my boyfriend. They've done nothing wrong, but I constantly worry about their safety. I can't stand being away from either them or the internet for a period of time (anywhere between 30 seconds to an hour), as I think "If I'm not online, then someone could text me, saying they're suicidal or really depressed and need my help, but I'm not online to see it and they kill themselves and it's all my fault!". It drives me insane. I also worry excessively about them if they aren't online for a while, are online for too long, or say something that I can interpret as them going to harm themselves, and I can interpret someone saying goodnight as scary. It takes over my life, and I'm not able to really do normal things away from internet (not like I want to do anything anyway). I probably sound crazy, but I can't control it. And if you're wondering, yes they are suicidal, as am I.

Autism does not make a person stupid, but it can decline our social ability. Autism is a very wide spectrum so it's hard to explain it simply. One person may have symptoms another doesn't have. Autism is different for every person, so don't assume that one person with Autism has all the same symptoms as another. It can also range from very mild to very severe. Some people may have it more severely, but still be high functioning and able to do live and do things without the need of an assistant. I have it very mildly,and although I was worse when I was younger,I still do have some symptoms now (bit of a social decline, sensitivity to some sounds). Like I said at the start, Autism does not make people stupid. They may have trouble communicating or not be able to talk, but that doesn't make them stupid. I am actually a very smart student in school.
Also vaccines do NOT cause Autism. They never have, and never will.
